$comment: Lunch-menu detection research, 2026-10-30. 113 Ikebukuro places from 6 Maps searches (ランチ/居酒屋/カフェ/ラーメン/焼肉/イタリアン) + the test store. Goal: find a stable way to tell 'has a DEDICATED lunch menu' without the Places API.

method.transport: No UI clicks. From any google.com/maps page: fetch('/maps/search/<q>?hl=ja') → HTML contains <link rel=preload href='/search?tbm=map&...pb=...'> → fetch it → JSON (strip )]}' prefix). Place list at J[64][i][1]. Details: fetch('/maps/place/<name>/data=!4m2!3m1!1s<fid>?hl=ja') → preload href '/maps/preview/place?...' → fetch → first array with length>100 and string at [11]. ~1.8 s/place sequential, 2 requests.
method.hl: Use hl=ja: attribute labels and review topics come back in Japanese (serves_lunch reads 'ランチメニューあり').

placeArrayIndexes.100: attributes; entries [ '/geo/type/establishment_poi/serves_lunch', label, [1,[[1|0,...]]] ]  1=yes 0=no; group 100.1 positive, 100.5 negative/unknown
placeArrayIndexes.118: secondary hours ('more hours'): [[typeName,null,null,[[day,..,..,[["11:30–14:30",[[11,30],[14,30]]]]]]]] — typeName 'ランチ' = owner-set lunch hours
placeArrayIndexes.203: regular hours, same day structure as 118

method.searchListOnly: Search-list entries (J[64]) are light: name/fid/attrs/hours/categories but NO 122/125/153/154/175. Details need the per-place fetch.

regexPitfalls: ランチ matches アランチーニ, フランチャコルタ, ブランチ → use (?<![ァ-ヺー])ランチ(?!ャ). Owner replies + machine translations in 175 repeat the same text in zh/en.

results.tierA_precision: 24/24 hand-checked = real lunch menus (e.g. 'ランチ Pranzo', 'LUNCH PLATE', 'ランチセット【平日】', 'SPECIAL LUNCH').

splitHoursWithoutTierA_webCheck.ギオットーネ (gorp.jp): yes — 平日ﾗﾝﾁ1,200円, separate Lunch page
splitHoursWithoutTierA_webCheck.Hulu-lu (own site): no dedicated lunch menu (ramen, same menu)

results.nano: Gemini Nano yes/no/unsure + quote on evidence snippets: 8/8 sensible, but 5–11 s per place and the queue stalled after 8 in a background tab → only for the ambiguous tier, never the bulk.

conclusion: Tier A (menu section/item or 'ランチ' secondary hours) is free, deterministic and precise but covers ~1/2 of true positives. Split hours (non-ramen) + linked hotpepper/tabelog/gorp page with a lunch tab recovers most of the rest. Owner text needs LLM judgment. serves_lunch attribute is useless for 'dedicated menu' (78/113).

tierB_liveCheck_2026-10-30.lesson: Nano says yes too easily even with few-shots; precision comes from the two deterministic gates (quote in input + concrete lunch item/price). Nano is effectively a quote extractor.
tierB_liveCheck_2026-10-30.minimizedWindow: Minimized Chrome window: rAF ~2 fps, CDP screenshots time out, Maps does not load more results. Not caused by the extension.

categoryRounds_2026-10-31.rateLimit: 346 req / 81 s OK; ~770 req within ~5 min (two areas back to back) → google.com/sorry. Gate: 4 in flight, 120 ms gap, max 300 starts per 5 min, 5 min cool-down on block.
